title: Electronegativity and bond polarity
basic_overview: Electronegativity is a relative tendency to attract shared electron density.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Across ↑; down ↓; then use vector addition for molecular dipole.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Compare EN. 2. Mark δ−/δ+. 3. Draw bond dipole. 4. Sum vectors using geometry.
extra_info_content.factors: Different EN scales are related but not identical.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
